beats.en: The French Revolution of 1789 introduced ideas of la patrie, the citizen, a tricolour flag and an elected National Assembly. The idea of a nation of equal citizens spread.

textbookBox.concept: Napoleon brought the Civil Code of 1804, also called the Napoleonic Code, which ended privileges by birth and made laws equal. It also removed customs barriers.

beats.en: Napoleon brought the Civil Code of 1804, also called the Napoleonic Code, which ended privileges by birth and made laws equal. It also removed customs barriers.
beats.speakEn: Napoleon brought the Civil Code of 1804, also called the Napoleonic Code, which ended privileges by birth and made laws equal. It also removed customs barriers.

beats.en: After Napoleon's defeat, European powers met at Vienna in 1815 and restored conservative rule. Liberal nationalists wanted a constitution, freedom of the press and free markets.
